Base Cost Setting From BOQ Baseline
Set Expense Tracking Base Cost by deducting Profit & Overhead (Materials & Labor) and Punchlist & Warranty Rework reserve
Base Cost Formulation: The contract Bill of Quantity (BOQ) rates include contractor Profit and Overhead (P&O). In internal site expense tracking, deducting target P&O percentages from BOQ materials and labor sets the direct operational output. From this net output, an additional percentage is deducted and set aside for Punchlist & Warranty Rework, establishing the true operational Base Cost spending ceiling for project execution.

Deduct margin for material supplier profit & procurement overhead.
